description: Prequal-only R0 load NLL table for the off-Mac sibling backend (joulewise/align/prequal.py SiblingBackend). Same format and verdict as configs/align/v4/r0_nll_reference.json (r0.validate_references / r0.nll_verdict); the sibling names its own revision (nll_reference_revision), so it can never be judged against D's entry. A sibling pass qualifies the R0 load code path only, never D's numerics (docs/align/v4/R0-LOAD-REFERENCE-NOTE.md, 'Prequal off-Mac').

tolerance.basis: D's bar (configs/align/v4/r0_nll_reference.json), which the R0 load executing review applied to this sibling for its fault-injection table (docs/align/reviews/2026-11-06-r0-load-reference-executing-review.md). Observed |mlx - hf32| on this fixture: 0.0005 (mlx bf16 0.4674), 0.0006 (mlx 8-bit 0.4663).

provenance.implementation: HF transformers 5.22.1, Qwen3_5DecoderLayer, float32 weights and activations, layer-streamed
provenance.upstream_revision_basis: The diagnosis did not record the 0.8B revision. Qwen/Qwen3.5-0.8B main has had no commit after 2026-03-02 (HF commit list read 2026-11-06), so main at the 2026-11-06 run is 2fc06364.
provenance.bins: Mean per-target NLL over consecutive 256-target bins of variants.hf32.start_0.per_token (2,048 targets), rounded to 4 decimals.
provenance.fixture: D's pinned R0 load ids (sha 792beb56...ac42); the sibling shares D's vocab and the prequal renders with D's tokenizer.
